matrix.title: Dispatcher × carrier matrix
matrix.description: Every dispatcher in this organization and the carriers currently assigned to them.
matrix.empty: No dispatcher has an active carrier assignment yet.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: Everything {dispatcherName} can currently see and act on — through a carrier assignment, a direct grant, or a group they own.
reach.empty: This dispatcher has no assignments yet.

grants.title: Direct resource grants
grants.description: Trucks, trailers, drivers and groups granted to this dispatcher individually, outside of any carrier assignment.
grants.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this dispatcher getting direct access?
grants.empty: No direct grants. This dispatcher's reach comes entirely from carrier assignments and groups.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: A group bundles carriers, trucks, trailers and drivers so they can be granted to a dispatcher together.
groups.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {groupName}? Dispatchers granted this group will lose the access it carries.

history.title: Assignment history
history.description: Every dispatcher this carrier has ever had, including ended assignments.
history.empty: This carrier has no assignment history yet.

errors.grantAlreadyActive: This dispatcher already has an active grant to that resource.

permissionDenied.title: Assignments are Admin-only
permissionDenied.description: Only an Administrator can assign carriers, equipment, drivers or groups to a dispatcher.
